# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 1 (Slot 75): Playable Golden Horde & Timurids (oe_pglh_). Generated by gen_playable_glh.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Idempotent initialization of Slot 75 Playable Golden Horde & Timurids state.
oe_pglh_init_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_init } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_init value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { tag = TIM }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_sedentary value = 30 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_sedentary value = 15 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_qarachi_balance value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_tabur_tier value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Shift sedentarization meter (clamped 0..100).
oe_pglh_shift_sedentary = {
	oe_pglh_init_host = yes
	change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_sedentary add = $amount$ }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_sedentary < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_sedentary value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_sedentary > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_sedentary value = 100 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Shift Qarachi Begs vs Khan centralization balance (clamped -100..+100).
oe_pglh_shift_qarachi = {
	oe_pglh_init_host = yes
	change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_qarachi_balance add = $amount$ }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_qarachi_balance < -100 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_qarachi_balance value = -100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_qarachi_balance > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_qarachi_balance value = 100 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Increment Steppe Tabur wagon-fort & artillery tier (clamped 0..4).
oe_pglh_bump_tabur = {
	oe_pglh_init_host = yes
	change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_tabur_tier add = $amount$ }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_tabur_tier < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_tabur_tier value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_tabur_tier > 4 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_tabur_tier value = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_tabur_tier >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_foundry_unlocked value = 1 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pglh_tabur_readiness_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
}

# Country scope. Verified EU5 1.4.9 sedentary transition: type = army -> location + monarchy + Gunpowder Khanate reform.
oe_pglh_enact_sedentary_empire = {
	oe_pglh_init_host = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { country_type = location } }
		change_country_type = location
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { government_type = government_type:monarchy } }
		change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = reformation_of_the_horde }
		remove_country_modifier = reformation_of_the_horde
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_pglh_ref_gunpowder_khanate } }
		add_reform = government_reform:oe_pglh_ref_gunpowder_khanate
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_settled_empire value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_foundry_unlocked value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_sedentary < 80 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_sedentary value = 80 }
	}
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pglh_new_yassa_charter_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
	add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
	custom_tooltip = oe_pglh_settle_done_tt
}

# Country scope. Advance Volga-Don Canal construction (stages 1 -> 2 -> 3).
oe_pglh_advance_volga_canal = {
	oe_pglh_init_host = yes
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage < 3 }
		change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage >= 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pglh_volga_canal_works_mod }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_pglh_volga_canal_works_mod
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pglh_volga_don_canal_complete years = 50 mode = replace }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pglh_volga_trade_open value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:astrakhan }
			location:astrakhan = {
				add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_pglh_volga_canal_port_loc_mod years = 50 mode = replace }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:tana }
			location:tana = {
				add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_pglh_volga_canal_port_loc_mod years = 50 mode = replace }
			}
		}
		oe_pglh_shift_sedentary = { amount = 15 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pglh_volga_canal_works_mod years = 6 mode = replace }
		oe_pglh_shift_sedentary = { amount = 8 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Snapshot local and read-only oe_ghh_ state for oe_pglh.90 readout.
oe_pglh_sync_readout = {
	oe_pglh_init_host = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_sedentary value = var:oe_pglh_sedentary }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_qarachi value = var:oe_pglh_qarachi_balance }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_tabur value = var:oe_pglh_tabur_tier }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_canal value = var:oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_pglh_settled_empire }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_settled value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_settled value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_type = location }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_landed value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_landed value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ghh_cohesion }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_ghh_coh value = global_var:oe_ghh_cohesion }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_ghh_coh value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ghh_phase }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_ghh_phase value = global_var:oe_ghh_phase }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_rd_ghh_phase value = -1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) monthly driver for an individual playable Golden Horde / Timurid host.
oe_pglh_tick_host = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_pglh_is_host = yes
			NOT = { var:oe_pglh_country_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_country_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
		oe_pglh_init_host = yes

		# Annual January sedentary drift (O(1): checks policy, reform, and read-only oe_ghh_ cohesion).
		if = {
			limit = { current_month = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_policy = oe_pglh_pol_darugha_cadastre }
				oe_pglh_shift_sedentary = { amount = 2 }
				oe_pglh_shift_qarachi = { amount = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_policy = oe_pglh_pol_suyurghal_patronage }
				oe_pglh_shift_sedentary = { amount = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_policy = oe_pglh_pol_qarachi_council }
				oe_pglh_shift_qarachi = { amount = -2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { oe_pglh_controls_sedentary_anchor = yes }
				oe_pglh_shift_sedentary = { amount = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { oe_pglh_ghh_cohesion_strong = yes tag = GLH }
				oe_pglh_shift_sedentary = { amount = 1 }
			}
		}

		# Chronological / milestone event dispatch (at most 1 event per host per month).
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:oe_pglh_ev_m ?= oe_ml_month_now } }
			if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1340 current_year <= 1370 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_1 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_1 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1378 current_year <= 1385 NOT = { tag = TIM } NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_2 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_2 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1386
					current_year <= 1396
					country_exists = c:GLH
					country_exists = c:TIM
					OR = { tag = GLH tag = TIM }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_3 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_3 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.3
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1395
					current_year <= 1420
					owns = location:sarai_al_jadid
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_4 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_4 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.4
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1390
					current_year <= 1450
					owns = location:samarkand
					OR = { tag = TIM has_variable = oe_pglh_adopted_host }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_5 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_5 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.5
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1420 current_year <= 1490 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_6 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_6 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.6
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1440
					current_year <= 1520
					owns = location:astrakhan
					OR = { owns = location:tana owns = location:kaffa }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_7 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_7 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.7
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					oe_pglh_can_settle_horde = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_8 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_8 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.8
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1520 current_year <= 1600 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_9 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_9 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.9
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1550
					current_year <= 1630
					oe_pglh_has_volga_canal_anchors = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_10 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_10 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1560
					current_year <= 1660
					oe_pglh_controls_sedentary_anchor = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_11 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_11 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.11
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1580
					current_year <= 1680
					oe_pglh_has_great_rival = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_12 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_12 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.12
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1680 current_year <= 1750 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_13 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_13 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.13
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1710 current_year <= 1780 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_14 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_14 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.14
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1750 current_year <= 1800 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_15 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_15 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.15
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1400
					OR = { country_exists = c:BYZ country_exists = c:ROM }
					OR = { country_exists = c:CHI country_exists = c:MNG }
					at_war = no
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pglh_ev_16 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_16 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.16
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any country scope (Slot 75 scheduler or oe_pglh_fallback_pulse). Deduped once per calendar month.
oe_pglh_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_pglh_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pglh_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:GLH }
			c:GLH = { oe_pglh_tick_host = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:TIM }
			c:TIM = { oe_pglh_tick_host = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:CRI c:CRI = { is_ai = no } }
			c:CRI = { oe_pglh_tick_host = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:ATR c:ATR = { is_ai = no } }
			c:ATR = { oe_pglh_tick_host = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_pglh_adopted_host }
			oe_pglh_tick_host = yes
		}
	}
}

# Dev Panel Page 76 Helper Effects (read-only safe & 1-click macros)

# Country scope. Adopt current human country as a Slot 75 steppe host for testing.
oe_pglh_dev_adopt_host = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_adopted_host value = 1 }
	oe_pglh_init_host = yes
	oe_pglh_sync_readout = yes
}

# Country scope. Page 76 Macro 1: Set sedentary = 80 and immediately execute army -> location monarchy transition.
oe_pglh_dev_macro_settle_empire = {
	oe_pglh_dev_adopt_host = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_sedentary value = 80 }
	oe_pglh_enact_sedentary_empire = yes
	oe_pglh_sync_readout = yes
}

# Country scope. Page 76 Macro 2: Complete Volga-Don Canal (stage 3) and boost Tabur corps readiness.
oe_pglh_dev_macro_volga_canal = {
	oe_pglh_dev_adopt_host = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_volga_canal_stage value = 2 }
	oe_pglh_advance_volga_canal = yes
	oe_pglh_bump_tabur = { amount = 2 }
	oe_pglh_sync_readout = yes
}

# Country scope. Page 76 Direct Event Launchers & Readout.
oe_pglh_dev_e3 = { oe_pglh_dev_adopt_host = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.3 }
oe_pglh_dev_e5 = { oe_pglh_dev_adopt_host = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.5 }
oe_pglh_dev_e8 = { oe_pglh_dev_adopt_host = yes set_variable = { name = oe_pglh_sedentary value = 80 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.8 }
oe_pglh_dev_e10 = { oe_pglh_dev_adopt_host = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.10 }
oe_pglh_dev_e15 = { oe_pglh_dev_adopt_host = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.15 }
oe_pglh_dev_readout = { oe_pglh_init_host = yes oe_pglh_sync_readout = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pglh.90 }

	remove_variable = oe_pglh_ev_m

	remove_variable = oe_pglh_ev_5
